2026_05_BUF_LA.headline: Allen’s rushing lanes and Rams’ run defense shape Monday showdown
2026_05_BUF_LA.paragraph1: Buffalo arrives in Los Angeles without defensive tackle Ed Oliver and receiver Joshua Palmer, while DJ Moore’s shoulder remains a concern. Josh Allen and James Cook can challenge the Rams’ run fits, but Matthew Stafford has Puka Nacua and Davante Adams to attack a Bills secondary that struggled against New England. Sean McVay is also monitoring Aaron Donald’s back and Jaylen Watson’s shoulder. Buffalo must contain Stafford’s intermediate throws while protecting Allen against Los Angeles pressure; the Rams must limit Cook without opening escape lanes for Allen.
2026_05_BUF_LA.model_rationale: Buffalo can stress Los Angeles with Cook’s rushing and Allen’s mobility, but its defensive absences threaten containment. The Rams need sound run fits and efficient Stafford possessions.
